movie.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
movie.overview: Isolated in the bell tower of Notre Dame, Quasimodo longs to experience the world beyond the cathedral walls, despite the wishes of his stern guardian, the Judge of Paris Claude Frollo. His first venture into the city leads him to Esmeralda, a fearless Romani woman whose defiance of Frollo's tyranny draws her—and Quasimodo—into his dangerous obsession.
movie.tagline: He dared to dream, he dared to love. This is the tale of a man… and a monster.
